notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

First major update is live! Here is some new features about new patch![/h3]


[h1]New Content[/h1]

[b][list]
[*] 3 more romance option added.
[*] 5 different relationship endings.
[*] 2 secret ending added.
[*] [spoiler] Now you can be with princess and heir to throne. [/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler] If you end with Merfit. You will have 1 secret reward.[/spoiler]
[*] Added 50 more levels to void.
[*] Added 25 new food recipes.
[*] Added 5 new drink recipes.
[*] Added 7 new items to marketplace.
[*] Now you can harvest fruits at dark woods.
[*] 2 different fruits added.
[/list][/b]


[h2]Bug Fix[/h2]
[b][list]
[*] Stuck on Finn's store fixed.
[*] Stuck while exiting void fixed.
[*] Save system stuck on bed fixed.
[*] Save system not saving fixed.
[*] Gold bugs when selling apple fixed.
[*] Running bug fixed.
[*] Day 24 event not triggering fixed.
[*] First event bug fixed.
[/list][/b]

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

[olist]
[*] [b]Equippable items will be added soon. (Armor,Weapon)
[*] Enchantment will be added soon.
[*] Chemistry will be added next update.
[*] Character customization will be added next update.[/b]
[/olist]


[h3][b]You can always contact me, give ideas and report bugs. I will continue to improve the game as much as I can and add new content.

[url=https://discord.gg/wV4aeH3nBF]Discord[/url]
[url=https://www.fallenkingdom.net/wiki]Wiki & Website[/url]
[/b][/h3]
ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: 1.02 Patch
notes.notes:
Hello Fallen Kingdom players. Here is the list of fixed bugs and improvements of [b]1.01[/b] patch.
If you find a bug, please shere with me at steam discussion page or Discord server. We will fix it ASAP.

[h1]The Void[/h1]
- Runing disabled in Void.
- The problem of not giving rewards when you get to each 5 level, has been fixed.
- Magiclands map changes.
- Solved the problem that the mouse cursor does not appear when you die in the void.


[h1]Game[/h1]
- Save system has been fixed.
- Some UI bugs has been fixed.
- Quit buttons fixed.
- Inventory save bugs has been fixed.

[h1]Niafell[/h1]
- Player bed has changed.
- Fixed stuck on bed after saving the game.
- When drinking at tavern, fixed respawn point after being drunk.
- The problem of not growing plants in the farming zone has been fixed
[spoiler]- Added 10 new dialogue.[/spoiler]
- Quests in guard tower bug has been fixed.
